EP03:E21 5500-7600 NOBLE MATRIARCH: "You have humiliated this family enough for one day."

EP03:E24 10000-12800 LADY JULIANA: "I was humiliated by your family."
EP03:E25 12900-15200 LADY JULIANA: "And my father said nothing."
EP03:E26 15100-17800 CAMERA: Medium close-up on the Noble Matriarch, completely unsympathetic.
EP03:E27 16100-18000 NOBLE MATRIARCH: "Your father has made his choice."
EP03:E28 17800-20000 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's stricken, vulnerable face.
EP03:E29 18100-20000 LADY JULIANA: "And what happens to me?"

EP03:E31 20100-21500 NOBLE MATRIARCH: "You leave."
EP03:E32 21600-22900 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana blinking in disbelief.
EP03:E33 21700-22900 LADY JULIANA: "Leave where?"
EP03:E34 22900-25500 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch looking down her nose in disdain.
EP03:E35 23000-25600 NOBLE MATRIARCH: "Wherever a discarded daughter belongs."
EP03:E36 25500-28400 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up focusing on Juliana's neck as her fingers desperately clutch the oval locket.

EP03:E39 28500-30700 LADY JULIANA: "I have every right to stand here."
EP03:E40 30800-32600 CAMERA: Tight close-up of the Noble Matriarch leaning in with vicious delight.
EP03:E41 30900-32600 NOBLE MATRIARCH: "Not anymore."
EP03:E42 32600-35800 CAMERA: Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch gesturing expansively to the filled cathedral nave behind her.
EP03:E43 32900-35800 NOBLE MATRIARCH: "Your father has chosen his family..."
EP03:E44 35800-37800 CAMERA: Close-up profile of the Noble Matriarch's piercing eyes glaring directly at Juliana.
EP03:E45 35900-37800 NOBLE MATRIARCH: "...and it isn't you."
EP03:E46 37800-39400 ACTION: The Noble Matriarch turns sharply toward the back of the chapel and barks an order.
EP03:E47 37900-39600 NOBLE MATRIARCH: "Guards! Remove her!"
EP03:E48 39600-41600 CAMERA: Medium shot as two royal guards in red uniforms and bearskin caps step in behind Juliana and seize her arms.
EP03:E49 40100-42100 ACTION: The guards forcefully grab Juliana by both shoulders and drag her backwards.
EP03:E50 40200-41900 LADY JULIANA: "Let me go!"
EP03:E51 41600-42800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's hand frantically grabbing the wooden rim of a pew, knuckles white with strain.
EP03:E52 42000-43100 LADY JULIANA: "Please! Someone!"
